name: auspost_parse_order_labels
description: Parse shipping label data to extract order details, products, and calculate total weight and dimensions. Supports label text with product codes (CFS, MVG, MVGEQ, MVGEM) and customer addresses.
short_description: Parse label data and calculate order dimensions

label_data.description:
Raw label text containing customer details and product codes. Each order should be in format: 'TO: Name
Address
City Postcode
State, Country
Ph: Phone
Email: Email

1 x PRODUCT_CODE'

returns.description: Parsed orders with calculated dimensions, weights, and box requirements

name: auspost_calculate_single_postage
description: Calculate postage cost for a single order using Australia Post PAC API. Supports both domestic (Australian) and international destinations. Returns available service options (Express Post, Parcel Post, etc.) with costs and delivery times.

postcode.description: Destination postcode (or zip code for international)

weight_kg.description: Total package weight in kilograms (e.g., 0.5 for 500g)

service_code.description: Optional: Specific service code (e.g., 'AUS_PARCEL_REGULAR', 'AUS_PARCEL_EXPRESS'). If omitted, returns all available services.

returns.description: Postage cost details with available services or specific service calculation

name: auspost_batch_calculate_postage
description: Process multiple orders from label data and calculate postage costs for each. Automatically parses labels, calculates dimensions, determines box sizes, and gets postage costs from Australia Post API. Returns comprehensive cost breakdown per order.
short_description: Batch calculate postage for multiple orders

label_data.description: Raw label text containing multiple orders separated by quotes. Format: "TO: Name\nAddress..." "TO: Name\nAddress..."

returns.description: Array of orders with parsed details, calculated postage costs, and service options

name: auspost_get_service_options
description: Get list of available Australia Post service options (Express Post, Parcel Post, Satchels, etc.) with descriptions and typical use cases. Helpful for understanding which service codes to use.

returns.description: List of service codes with descriptions and typical costs
